title: Masuka family seeks witnesses
article: The family of a man who was shot dead by police on New Year's eve appeal to witnesses to contact the Special Investigation Unit or the family's lawyer.
Henry Masuka demanded immediate medical attention for his ill daughter at St. Michael's Hospital in Toronto, but what happened next remains unclear, says his family.
Police say Masuka took a doctor hostage and when negotiations with him failed they shot him dead.
And they say he had a fake gun.
But the family's lawyer, Miguna Miguna said, "We have not been able to corroborate that. We do not know as far as we're concerned, what happened that day."
The Black Action Defence Committee is concerned that this may be yet another innocent black person shot dead by Police.
Lawyer Peter Rosenthal backed that assertion, saying, "If you look over the history of police shootings in Toronto there's a very disturbing number of black people among the victims."
John Masuka, Henry's father, is appealing for help to raise Henry's four children.
"We don't have any sources, so it's the community. We're appealing to everyone with a single cent. We are really in need. As you see it's hard to handle," he said.
The SIU says the investigation into this case is almost complete, and it doesn't expect any charges will be laid.
